description: Creation of a ceramic tile mural to celebrate William Morris and his 1880 journey along the Thames, to be mounted on the road side of the river wall to the Upper Mall across from Kelmscott House, William Morris' home in Hammersmith.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date on which this consent is granted.

Condition required to be imposed by Section 18(1) (a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings/documents, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

Site Plan, Elevation & Cross-Section WMM.01dr, William Morris Mural - Design, William Morris Mural - Method Statement and Maintenance Plan dated November 2026 received 17/11/2026. 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be maintained in perpetuity in accordance with the submitted maintenance plan dated November 2026 received 17/11/2026. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
